text: I think you'll really enjoy this Creamy Oven-Baked Risotto recipe. It's a comforting, creamy dish that features ingredients you seem to like, such as milk and parmesan cheese. The fact that it's a stovetop-free recipe, cooked in the oven, might also appeal to you. Given your preference for rolls-biscuits and seasoning salt, I'm guessing you might appreciate the savory flavors in this recipe. Plus, it's ready in about 40 minutes, which is right in line with the cooking time of many recipes you've liked in the past.
